settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.text: Every order ships free with Aramex, tracked from our door to yours, anywhere in South Africa.

settings.title: Free delivery
settings.text: Door-to-door with Aramex on every order. No minimum spend, nothing extra at checkout.

settings.title: Same-day dispatch
settings.text: Order before 13:00 on a weekday and it leaves us that day. Later orders go out the next working day.

settings.title: 2–4 working days
settings.text: To main centres. Outlying and rural areas usually take 3–6 working days.

settings.title: Tracked all the way
settings.text: We email your Aramex tracking number as soon as your parcel is collected.

settings.note: Weekends and South African public holidays aren't working days for dispatch or delivery.

settings.heading: The details
settings.text:
Where we deliver. Anywhere in South Africa, including outlying areas. We don't ship internationally yet.

Getting your address right. Include your complex or estate name, unit number and suburb. A work address is a good idea if nobody is home during the day. Add a cellphone number so the Aramex driver can reach you.

If you miss the driver. Aramex will contact you to arrange another delivery, or let you collect from your nearest Aramex branch.

Lost or damaged parcels. If your parcel goes missing or arrives damaged, contact us. We'll deal with Aramex and send you a replacement or refund you. You don't have to chase anyone.

settings.question: Can I collect my order instead?
settings.answer: We don't offer collection at the moment, but delivery is free and usually quick.

settings.question: Can you deliver to a PO Box?
settings.answer: No. Aramex needs a physical street address and a contact number.

settings.question: My tracking hasn't updated in a while
settings.answer: Tracking sometimes only updates when a parcel is scanned at a depot. If there's been no movement for 2 working days, send us your order number and we'll follow up with Aramex.
